cohort: Single fetus pregnancies with at least one intramural leiomyoma at the Xiangya Hospital from May 1st, 2017 to May 1st, 2019
finding: Pregnant women who conceived through IVF experienced significantly higher leiomyoma growth, particularly during the first trimester, and had a higher occurrence of pregnancy complications such as preterm birth, cesarean birth, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth rate was higher in the IVF group (80.5%) compared to the spontaneous pregnancy group (69.4%).
